name: Archivist
description: Reads your chats with your other bots for standing rules like "always" and "never", then with your OK writes the missing ones into each bot so they stop forgetting.

name: iBot Player
description: Your own iPod-style player for Apple Music, deployed to your Vercel in about 15 minutes. Click wheel included.

name: Security Audit Bot
description: Audits code you own, from a GitHub link or a folder, and hands back a private report that opens with the fixes to make first.

name: Christian Devotional Bot
description: A daily devotional fitted to your tradition and translation: Scripture quoted accurately, a short reflection, a prayer, and one thing to practice.

name: Terminal Boss
description: Run terminal jobs and coding agents like Claude Code, Codex or Grok Build on your own computer, straight from chat.

name: Apple Inventory & Deal Bot
description: Finds the exact Apple product you want in stock and shows who can get it to you soonest and cheapest.

name: Sushi & Ramen
description: Finds sushi and ramen worth eating and gets it to your door with one yes.

name: BotBagger
description: Your bot designs products, runs its own shop, and sells them on the BotBagger store.

name: Site Coach
description: A plain-English coach for your site's Google traffic and SEO, with a weekly brief and a look at where AI search skips you.

name: Apple Desk
description: Connects your bot to Reminders, Calendar, Notes, Contacts and Messages on your Mac.

name: Grokbot Mail
description: A Liquid Glass, iPhone-first mailbox for your Grok Bot's own email address, hosted on your own Vercel.

name: App Store Connect
description: Walks you through shipping an iOS app: API key, TestFlight, listing copy, framed screenshots, and a pre-review check.

name: Coach
description: Plans your workouts, logs sets and meals from a quick text or a plate photo, and adjusts to your WHOOP, Oura or Fitbit recovery.

name: Mail in X Chat
description: Your important email as short cards in one X Chat. Reply from there, and nothing sends until you say yes.

name: iMessage Relay
description: Your iMessages in X Chat, so you can read and reply from there. Setup on your Mac takes about a minute.

name: Reel ➡️ 𝕏
description: Paste an Instagram, TikTok or YouTube Shorts link and get back an X-ready MP4 plus a post that credits the creator.

name: Disk Doctor
description: Finds what's eating your Mac's storage, scans before touching anything, and deletes only the groups you approve.

name: Claude Remote
description: Text it a task from your phone. It runs it in Claude Code on your Mac and pings you when it's done.

name: Package Pal
description: Reads your shipping emails and sends one daily digest of everything in transit, plus alerts when something changes.

name: Home Scout
description: Watches new listings and checks each good fit against real comps, commute, schools and permits.

name: Afterglow
description: A daily read on your X posts: what moved, what got replies, and what died.

name: Starlink Check
description: Checks whether Starlink home internet reaches your address, with plans, prices and promos, and can ping you when it does.

name: Vuln Scout
description: Watches public CVE and patch advisories and drops short defensive digests as Pages.

name: Last Call
description: Catches the trials you sign up for, warns you a few days before they charge, and offers to cancel.

name: Burn Rate
description: A weekly audit that trims your bots' wasteful routines, with your approval.
